name: Shigure
source:
A young leader of the Gohongatana Clan (lit., "Five Swords Clan" or "Five Katanas Clan"), a group of shamans who, since ancient times, have been in charge of the Emperors' burials and other religious ceremonies, unbeknownst to the general public. They possess secret arts and mystic tools that they use to perform sacred rites, exorcism and divination, and can also utilize for fighting and self-defense. However, due to certain circumstances, the Gohongatana Clan clashed with the military, and was removed from the government affairs. 
Currently, Shigure opposes the military's plans and is in direct conflict with them, which puts his life in danger.

"Kyouichirou, so you are happy to pamper such a handsome man as me? That's great, I'll borrow your lap as a pillow or whatever again, so look forward to it." — Shigure
 
"Don't worry, I will stop your blow without fail." — Shigure
